evidence_kind: reported live measurements plus synthetic regression checks

live_failure.human_observation: Beat and spoken follow-up heard; no phone pulses seen.
live_failure.premature_attach_receipt: running returned before any phone effect

inference: The observed 197 ms acknowledgment exceeds the old 166.667 ms window. An always-sufficient old window is disproven; a hardware flashing speed limit is not established.

controlled_baseline.scheduling: Strictly future beat on the existing absolute phase; stale unsent ON edges skipped, no backlog.
controlled_baseline.receipt: Participant remains pending until its first correlated ON and OFF both acknowledge. UNKNOWN fails attachment with exact device identity, stops future edges, and is not replayed.
controlled_baseline.authorization: Exact captured lease, controller generation, connection and capability rechecked after Bus queue. Pending status remains readable; revocation/stop can settle pending attachment.

limits.confidence: Ten ACK samples justify a gentler feasibility baseline; they do not establish reliability or physical synchronization.
